mapper.select: select s.id,re.reid reid,u.user_name userName,s.top_number ,d.dept_id,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name, s.top_type,s.party_A,s.party_B, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, s.signing_data, s.validity_Date,re.re_amount ,re.reamount_url,re.account_data,s.contract, s.filing, re.state,re.createtime,re.amount_type from sci_horizontal_reamount re join sci_horizontal_apply s on s.id = re.apply_id left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id where re.state in (99,1,2,11,22,5,6) and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%') and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and state = #{state} and YEAR(DATE_ADD(signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = #{year} and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%') and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and state = #{state} and YEAR(DATE_ADD(account_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = #{year} ${params.dataScope} order by case -- 草稿 when re.state = 99 then 1 -- 审批中 when re.state in (1,2,11) then 2 -- 已完结 when re.state = 6 then 3 end, re.createtime desc
